text.text_excerpt: This is actually a cool, little bar. Some friends of mine actually own the bar but I'm giving a completely unbiased opinion here. I mean, that's just what I do. The last few times I tried to get into this establishment, the place was absolutely packed to the seams with people. They had the Fulton St. entrance blocked off and ONLY allowed people to enter from S Peters. They were also charging a $10 cover and since I didn't particularly enjoy the sounds emanating from the joint, I decided to pass. On another occasion, I came in on a Tuesday after a brew release from Gordon Biersch and found the bar completely devoid of any customers. So, this was my first REAL trip through the entire bar. Happened upon this place on a Wednesday, which is the night they feature a brass band. The place was filled with tourists who were all sitting around enjoying the show. Come on tourists how can you sit while watching a brass band? Shortly after my friends and I walked in and straight up to the dance floor, the band got the crowd moving and made everybody dance. It was so neat to see the whole place rise up and start moving and shaking. The beer selection could be better (my usual complaint), but at least there's Brother Thelonious. I like the layout of the space most. A long bar for serving and lounge seating are available in the entrance space, which is great if you want to hear your con...

Stopped by here for the first time the other day, and so far I'm definitely a fan. We were only there for a few minutes, but the staff was super helpful, the space is pretty awesome, and I can't wait to go see a show here! The bar is divided in half, so one side is the bar, with a couple of lounge areas (couches and so forth) and a pool table. The other side is the music venue part, with a stage and what looks like plenty of room to dance. Plus a couple highboy cocktail tables here and there for good measure. It's been open less than a year, but still, I've been remiss in not having been here yet. As I said, so far I'm a fan. I'll report back soon when I've had a chance to spend some more...
